question: Using ASTER bands 10-12 data, compute the Land Surface Temperature (LST) using the Three-Temperature Method (TTM) and calculate the maximum LST for the entire study area.
final_answer_preview:
The maximum Land Surface Temperature (LST) for the study area, calculated using the Three-Temperature Method (TTM) with ASTER bands 10-12, is **307.70 K**.

This value represents the highest temperature recorded in the entire area covered by the LST raster output.
